nina.s: FYI - CreditUnion X wants a short POC to validate BYOK + HSM integration. They need automatic rotation every 24 hours and a proof-of-non-exposure report. Asking for cost and timeline.

paul.c: Are they asking to import CMKs or keep master keys in their HSM and call Unwrap/Wrap via proxy? Also any vendor preference?

olga.sec: They prefer Thales but can use CloudHSM. Requirements: FIPS, signed attestation, dual control, and tamper evidence. They also want signed rotation events. We'll need to provide a KMS API contract.

mike.ops: Ops notes: if they want 24h rotation with no key material on our hosts, we'll proxy all wrap/unwrap to their HSM. Latency bump estimated +25ms. Need allowed IPs and expected qps. For POC 25 qps estimate. Suggest Dedicated slot for production.

nina.s: Timeline: POC can be 2 weeks if security & ops can produce runbook + curl examples. Pricing ask: POC estimate, monthly 25qps vs 250qps, and attestation uplift.

paul.c: Ballpark: POC $3k setup + $1k infra. Monthly @25qps $3k + $1k ops. Monthly @250qps $20k + $4k ops. Attestation add-on $5k one-time + $500/mo. Need finance to confirm.

security-bot: Attached standard BYOK FAQ and HSM attestation checklist.

olga.sec: I'll assemble the questionnaire responses and the key ceremony runbook. Also recommend using our ephemeral CEK model.

mike.ops: I'll create a minimal stress test and a small agent to proxy PKCS#11 calls.

nina.s: Great. I'll set a prep call for Thurs. Thanks everyone.
